**Assignment:** [08 handoff](08-V0.1.0-RECOVERY-AND-APPROVED-UPGRADES.md) · [09 checkpoint](09-V0.1.0-COMPLETE-DECISION-CHECKPOINT.md) · [07](07-V0.1.0-ACCURACY-AND-FOUNDATIONS.md) · design [18](../design/18-ITEMS-NOTES-BOX-SHOWCASE-GUIDES-AND-MAPS.md), [19](../design/19-SYNERGY-POKEDEX-REFERENCE.md), [20](../design/20-WEBSITES-LINKS-AND-KEYBOARD-SHORTCUTS.md)

## Recovery
The interrupted session's work was still in the workspace, uncommitted: schema v3, the item importer, availability registry v3, the library services and routes, `i18n.js`, `links.js` and the Item Library page. Nothing was lost.

The new `origin/develop` commits only touched docs, so they fast-forwarded cleanly on top of the uncommitted code. The recovered work was finished, tested and committed as `b7c9c02`, followed by `6529703`, `3fa8856` and this documentation commit.

## Update and run on CachyOS (Bash, one step at a time)
1. Close every Companion window (main window and all popouts) and quit it from the tray icon (**Quit**). PokeMMO itself can stay open or closed; it is not affected.
2. Check your checkout has no local edits:
   ```bash
   cd ~/Documents/Haqzo-Projects/PokeMMO-Companion
   git status
   ```
   If it lists modified files, stop and keep a copy of them first.
3. Update:
   ```bash
   git fetch origin && git switch develop && git pull --ff-only
   ```
4. Start:
   ```bash
   ./run.sh
   ```
5. Optional tests:
   ```bash
   python3 -m pytest -q tests --deselect tests/ui
   ```

On first start your data in `~/.local/share/pokemmo-companion/` is upgraded from schema v2 to v4. A backup `pre-migration-v2-to-v4-*.sqlite3` is written to the backups folder first, and existing runs, ticks, registration, notes, favourites, settings and window sizes are kept.

To get the Item Library, form sprites and Spanish/Chinese item names, re-install your dump once: Settings › Data › **Install** (or the Home banner). Your original files are only read, never modified.

## What was built

### Pokédex accuracy and the Synergy-style catalog
- **Availability registry format 3** (`companion/data/pokemmo_availability.json`, version `2026-11-22.2`) keeps these as separate axes:
  - in-game Pokédex listing;
  - acquisition methods, each with confidence, sources, date verified and the game patch it applies to;
  - which counters it can count toward (Seen / Owned / Caught OT / Alpha / Shiny / Costume);
  - your own in-game checks.
  No axis is inferred from another.
- **Corrected entries:**
  - **Virizion #640:** permanent 6★ raid at Pinwheel Forest. Sources: Lunar New Year 2026 changelog, the PokeMMO forum guides, PikaMMO and MMOBreeder.
  - **Cobalion #638** and **Terrakion #639:** permanent raids.
  - **Heatran, Cresselia and Meloetta:** raids (REPORTED where only one source exists).
  - **Roaming birds and beasts:** roamers.
  - **Shaymin:** seasonal raid (Lunar New Year).
  - **Zekrom:** story-temporary.
  - **Rayquaza, Arceus and Keldeo:** temporary/contested modes.
  - **Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Genesect:** event registration (REPORTED).
  - **Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus:** *unknown*. They were previously wrongly shown as "not in dex".
- **No forced totals.** 604/603 are stored only as a dated observation from one client. The report never subtracts from them. You can record your own counter readings.
- **Patch review.** A record verified before a later patch that affects it is flagged "Needs review". Your dump's date is recorded (2026-11-16, after the 29 Jul 2026 encounter overhaul).
- **Forms catalog:** 649 species + 82 forms = **731 entries**, matching Synergy's public index.
  - Parity is checked against the set of normalized `(species_id, form_key)` keys, not the count. The test fixture stores only Synergy's public entry slugs; no Synergy data, text or images.
  - Form stats, types and abilities were authored independently. They agree with all 18 form records in your client dump. Two of those (Deoxys Attack/Defense) carry the client label "Egg", so their egg sprites are never shown.
  - A form is never assumed obtainable. Form changes that need an item or event show "Form change not verified".
  - Forms never add to your Seen/Owned counts.
- **UI:**
  - Generation headings, form badges and a form switcher in the detail view.
  - An availability panel per axis with sources.
  - The availability report.
  - A "Hide species I marked Not listed" filter.
  - Wild location headers link to the Location explorer.
  - Popouts list all 731 entries in every mode.

### Item Library
- The importer reads all **3,006 item records** from your dump and groups them into **2,090 items**, keeping every source ID as an alias (5083 and 83 are both Thunderstone).
- **2,986 records have an icon** and 20 do not. Icons are PNG-validated and stored only in your private data folder.
- **Categories** are inferred from names and descriptions; each item shows which rule assigned its category.
- **Links between tools:**
  - "Held by wild Pokémon" and "Used for evolution" are linked through item IDs in your dump.
  - TMs link to their move.
  - Breeding items link to the Breeding planner.
- **Your own data:** favourites, manual owned quantities and linked notes.
- **Languages:** Spanish/Chinese names and descriptions come from your client's `XML-Strings` where translated (1,069 items).
- A popout is included.

### Notes
- **Editing:** create; autosave; title and body (with a light Markdown preview); tags; colour; pin.
- **Links** to Pokémon, items, locations, your guides and Box entries.
- **Organising:** archive; trash with Undo; Restore; Delete forever only from the trash; duplicate.
- **Search, filters and export:** search; tag filter; Markdown and JSON export.
- **Floating Notes popout:**
  - Compact is one note.
  - Standard adds tags and links.
  - Expanded shows the list next to the editor.
  - The popout ignores its own save events, so typing is never interrupted.
- Per-species Pokédex notes remain a separate feature and are listed read-only.

### My Box, Showcase, My guides, Location explorer
- **My Box** records individual Pokémon with validated fields:
  - IVs 0–31; EVs 0–252 each and 510 total; up to 4 moves; nature, gender, region and obtain method;
  - Shiny, Secret shiny and Alpha;
  - your own picture (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP, max 5 MB, kept locally).

  It never changes your Pokédex registration, except through the explicit "Copy to Pokédex registration…" button, which has Undo.
- **Showcase:**
  - Grid, Minimal and Featured (cycling) layouts, with background, opacity and motion options.
  - OT, IVs and encounter counts are hidden unless you switch them on.
  - A popout for streaming.
- **My guides:**
  - Your own checklists with headings, indents, links and pictures.
  - Import from .txt, .md, .odt, .docx or .html.
  - Repeatable cycles with history, e.g. gym reruns. Ticks survive reordering.
  - Markdown export and a floating checklist popout.
- **Location explorer** (maps, phase 1):
  - Region → location lists with every encounter row from your dump.
  - Linked both ways with the Pokédex, plus notes and your guides.
  - No map artwork, Sevii Islands or interactive map yet.

### Websites & links
- **Tools › Websites & links**, also available in Quick Access.
- **Defaults:** PokeMMO Forums, PokeMMO, PokeMMO Support, Team Synergy and PokeMMO Hub are added **once**. A default you delete or edit is never re-added or overwritten; "Restore default links" brings them back only when you click it.
- **Managing links:** add, edit, delete with Undo, favourite, reorder, categories, search, copy address.
- **Opening:** opens in your default browser — Qt `QDesktopServices` natively, the system browser otherwise. The stored URL is re-validated at open time, and failures are reported rather than hidden.
- **Allowed addresses:** only `https://`. javascript:, data:, file:, http:, custom app schemes, credentials and local/private addresses are rejected.
- No PokeMMO Hub data, prices or API.

### Keyboard shortcuts
- **Settings › Keyboard shortcuts:**
  - The list is searchable and grouped by tool.
  - Record a key combination, clear it or reset it; "Reset all" resets everything.
  - Conflicts with another action are shown and can be replaced on confirmation.
  - Reserved keys (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+W, Alt+F4, the Alt+1–5 navigation, …) are rejected.
  - Physical keys are used, so bindings work the same on any keyboard layout.
- **Default Storyline bindings** (they work while the Guides page or the Storyline popout is focused):
  - **Next objective:** Ctrl+Shift+→
  - **Previous objective:** Ctrl+Shift+←
  - **Tick / untick current objective:** Ctrl+Shift+Enter
- **How Storyline actions behave:**
  - They run on the server against the active character run and region.
  - Ticking never moves the current step.
  - At the first or last step nothing changes.
  - A stale-step guard and a per-key-press dedupe prevent double ticks from several windows.
  - Key auto-repeat is ignored.
  - Shortcuts never fire while you type or while a dialog is open.
- **Also available:** show/hide the Storyline popout, new note, the Notes popout, Pokédex search and next/previous entry, Items search, Websites search, Home.
- **No system-wide hotkeys.** The setting refuses them, and nothing is ever sent to PokeMMO.

### Popouts, settings and languages
- **Text size:** a single button opens a popover with a 60–200 % slider, presets, Reset and an "Outline text" option for see-through backgrounds. It replaces A−/A+.
- **Background opacity** can now go down to 20 %.
- **New native popouts:** notes, items, showcase, customguide, locations and box.
- **Language:**
  - English is complete. Spanish and Chinese are **beta**: navigation, common buttons and the new tools are translated; the older pages are still English.
  - The translations have not been reviewed by native speakers.
  - Pokémon names stay English because the dump has no translated species names.
  - Switch with the toolbar globe or Settings › Language, which shows coverage. Missing keys fall back to English.

### Calculators
- **Damage calculator removed:** navigation, Quick Access (saved pins are cleaned up on start), routes and the hub card.
- **Badges:** tools no longer carry Experimental/Verified badges. Uncertainty is shown next to individual values.
- **Catch:**
  - Gen III/IV formula with integer floors and four shake checks.
  - Every ball is evaluated against your inputs (turn, time, cave, water, level, types, caught before).
  - Each ball shows a "condition not confirmed" note where PokeMMO behaviour is unverified.
  - Balls needed for 90 % and 99 %.
  - Lickitung's catch rate is set to 75 (30 Oct 2026 patch), even with an older dump.
  - The Twist Mountain Dusk Ball note is kept.
- **Stats:** EVs 252 per stat and 510 total, integer floors, Shedinja, form base stats, and Level 50/100 side by side.
- **EV planner:** horde ×1/×3/×5, current → target EVs, and Macho Brace ×2 (labelled as the mainline effect, not confirmed for PokeMMO). Power items and Pokérus are not applied.
- **Breeding:**
  - Fixed baseline prices of ¥10,000 per brace or Everstone; your own prices override them.
  - Reference tree counts: 2×31 → 2 starters (¥20,000), 3×31 → 4 (¥65,000), 4×31 → 8 (¥155,000), 5×31 → 16 (¥340,000).
  - 5×31 + nature → 32 starting parents and 31 breeds.
  - No GTL prices.

## Data migrations
| Schema | Adds | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| v3 | notes and note links, Item Library favourites/quantities, My Box, showcases, custom guides with steps and cycles, media, your counter readings | additive; per-species notes unchanged |
| v4 | bookmarks | defaults seeded once (meta flag `bookmarks_seeded`) |

Before migrating, a backup copy of the database is written (`pre-migration-vX-to-v4`). The migrations are idempotent: re-opening an upgraded database does nothing. Tests cover upgrades from v1, v2 and v3. JSON backups include every new table. Box/guide pictures live in `media/` and are not inside the JSON.

## Test results (cloud workspace, this pass)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| Backend + golden dump (with your dump) | **197 passed** |
| Backend without dump | 181 passed, 16 skipped (dump-only) |
| UI flows (Playwright + Chrome, with dump): `test_ui_flows.py` + `test_ui_foundations.py` | **29 passed, 2 failed** on the full run. Both were fixed (a selector, and the text-size popover going off-window at 150 %), then pass when re-run on their own; the full suite was not re-run after that fix |
| Native shell wiring (mocked PySide6 stub) | passed |

The new tests cover:
- **Calculators:** capture formula and ball conditions, Lickitung 75, stat golden cases (Garchomp Jolly spread at level 50 and 100, Shedinja, limits), EV arithmetic, breeding counts, the 32/31 tree and baseline prices.
- **Catalog and availability:** 731-key parity (a missing key is detected even when the total still matches); Virizion and the raid legends; temporary modes never counted as permanent.
- **Data:** item aliases and icons; Notes CRUD and the trash rules.
- **Websites:** seeding once and never re-inserting; URL attack cases; open via the stored URL only.
- **Shortcuts and Guides:** shortcut normalization, conflicts, reserved keys and reset; guide next/prev/toggle, boundaries, dedupe and per-character isolation.
- **Migrations and backups:** v1/v2/v3 → v4 and backup round-trips.
- **UI:** popout scroll to entry 731, form detail, Item Library, Notes and the Notes popout, Websites, Guide shortcuts including no firing while typing, rebinding, text-size popover, language switch, Damage calculator absent.

During this pass, Playwright HTML5 drag-and-drop of a Pokédex card into Quick Access hung, but only when run straight after the type-chart test. The test now pins Pikachu from its detail page instead. Dragging cards was checked manually in the workspace browser.

## Not verified — please check on your machine
1. **Native Qt on KDE (Wayland/XWayland):**
   - The six new popouts.
   - Opening links through `QDesktopServices` in your default browser.
   - The text-size popover inside native windows.
   - Shortcuts inside native popouts.

   None of this was run on real KDE; only the mocked stub was tested. KDE Wayland does not allow reliable system-wide hotkeys, so shortcuts work only while a Companion window is focused.
2. **Windows** was not tested.
3. **In-game Pokédex listing:** every species still shows "Not checked yet" until you mark it — the registry deliberately does not guess.
4. **Raid details:** prerequisites and lockouts come from community sources (REPORTED/CORROBORATED). Meloetta and Heatran rely on a single source.
5. **Capture details:**
   - PokeMMO-specific values for Nest, Dusk, Quick, Timer, Dive and Dream Balls are not confirmed.
   - Alpha and raid capture rules are not modelled.
   - The formula follows public PokeMMO calculators; there is no official PokeMMO capture formula.
6. **Form changes** that need items (Plates, Drives, Reveal Glass, DNA Splicers, Gracidea, Griseous Orb) are not verified in PokeMMO. Kyurem fusions, Therian formes and Keldeo Resolute have no record in your client dump.
7. **Item categories** are heuristics. Region codes on item records are shown raw.
8. **Spanish/Chinese** cover only the new tools and navigation, and have not been reviewed by native speakers.
9. **Maps:** no artwork, no Sevii Islands, no event or swarm overlay.
10. **Showcase** has no OBS-specific transparent-window mode yet: it uses the normal popout opacity.

## Suggested review-video order
1. Close the Companion fully, update, start, and confirm your runs and ticks are still there after the upgrade.
2. **Settings › Data:** re-install your dump; check the item count and the "dated 2026-11-16" line.
3. **Pokédex:** "731 of 731 entries", the Generation headings, then Rotom's forms and Deoxys Attack (base sprite note).
   - Virizion: permanent raid with sources.
   - Tornadus: unknown.
   - Then open the **Availability report** and record today's counter reading.
4. **Pokédex popout:** Compact → Expanded, scroll to Genesect Chill Drive.
5. **Item Library:** search "thunder", open Thunderstone, set a quantity, link a note. Switch the language to Español and check item names.
6. **Notes:** create a note, tag it, link Feebas and Route 119, delete it, Undo, then pop the note out and type in it.
7. **My Box:** add a shiny with a screenshot, add it to a Showcase, then open the Showcase popout.
8. **My guides:** import a .md checklist, tick steps, then "Finish cycle & start next".
9. **Websites & links:** open the PokeMMO Forums, add your own link, delete Hub, restart and confirm it stays deleted.
10. **Settings › Keyboard shortcuts**, then **Guides:** use Ctrl+Shift+→ / ← / Enter in the main window and in the Storyline popout.
11. **Popout text-size button:** slider, 150 %, outline, Reset.
12. **Tools:** Catch (night + Dusk Ball, turn 1 + Quick Ball), Stats (level 50/100), EV planner, Breeding plan (5×31 + nature = 32/31). Check that the Damage calculator is gone.
